title: Differential Backup
description: Learn how to create and restore differential backups.

data.text: A differential backup captures all changes since the last full backup. It is faster and uses less storage than a full backup.

data.title: Create a differential backup
data.content: Creates a differential backup of the HR database.

data.text: To restore from a differential backup, first restore the full backup, then restore the differential backup:

data.title: Restore full then differential backup
data.content: Restores full backup first, then differential backup.

data.title: Differential Backup Key Points
points: Differential backups capture changes since the last full backup.
They are faster and smaller than full backups.
Always restore the full backup before the differential backup.
Use NORECOVERY when restoring multiple backups.
